subject: Carry cases routing + spare graphic approval for booth kiosks
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@expoart.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Carry cases routing + spare graphic approval for booth kiosks

Hi team —

Two quick items to lock down for DevCon next week: routing for the demo carrycases (we have five demo kiosks) and approval for the spare front graphic that Nina's shop will bring as a fallback.

1) Carrycases: Exhibit hall freight is arriving Wed night. Freight team (BrightSign Logistics) can stage a dedicated "tech carry" crate at Dock 4 if we confirm a crate manifest by EOD Wed. That crate should contain: 5 padded carrycases, 3 spare HDMI extenders, 2 spare power bricks, and the kiosk vendor toolkits. I attached an updated crate manifest (crate_manifest_v2.xlsx).

2) Spare graphic: Nina sent a front-panel spare we can use if the main print gets damaged in transit. See attached PDF (graphics_spare-front-v3.pdf). Two asks: Marissa — can you confirm content/brand compliance? Marcus — can you confirm safe margin and cutline for the LED frame?

Proposed ops: BrightSign drops the carry crate at Dock 4 on Thursday 08:00–10:00. FreightPlus (Tom) will hotshot the spare graphic to show site if we need it during load-in; cost estimate in his note below.

If we can get confirmations today, I'll lock the staging window with BrightSign and finalize shipping labels (I'll send the label once shipping is booked).

Thanks —
Sergio
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
(attachment: crate_manifest_v2.xlsx)
(attachment: graphics_spare-front-v3.pdf)

From: Nina Patel <nina@expoart.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightSign Logistics <ops@brightsignlogistics.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Carry cases routing + spare graphic approval for booth kiosks

Thanks for the heads-up, Sergio.

A few notes from production/logistics:
- The PDF you sent previews fine. We exported at 300dpi and built bleed to 0.125in. Marcus, if you want a +0.0625in safety margin on the left edge for the LED channel, we can do a quick re-export and still make the Friday print run.
- We'll include a sealed sleeve with vinyl adhesive tabs so the spare can be applied onsite without dismounting the frame.
- We can bring a spare hold-for-pickup label but recommend you use FreightPlus for the hotshot if you want same-day delivery onsite during load-in; BrightSign can stage the crate but their drivers won't perform onsite installs.

Estimated cost for FreightPlus hotshot (door-to-door, same day): $420 — includes a two-person lift and 2-hour local hold. If you want me to route the work order, say the word and I'll assign their pickup to Tom (cc'd).

Nina
Lead Production Manager
ExpoArt Co.
(attachment: print_ready_notes.txt)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Nina Patel <nina@expoart.com>, BrightSign Logistics <ops@brightsignlogistics.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Carry cases routing + spare graphic approval for booth kiosks

Appreciate the details. Quick approvals and a small request:

- Graphics: Approved pending the +0.0625in safety margin on the left edge (Marcus, please confirm and Nina can re-export). Also confirm the safe-zone for any sponsor lockups has 0.25in padding from the edge.
- Crate staging: Dock 4 OK. Logan — can you confirm a floor marshal will be at Dock 4 at 08:30 to receive BrightSign and sign off on the crate?
- Spare placement: Please label the spare graphic "Hold for Redwood — Booth C12" and put it in the top of the crate with foam separators so it doesn't get scuffed.

I'll approve FreightPlus hotshot if Sergio OKs the $420 expense. Otherwise we'll rely on BrightSign staging and Nina will keep the spare in her van until load-in.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Events Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachment: none)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@expoart.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@freightplus.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Carry cases routing + spare graphic approval for booth kiosks

Looks good — +0.0625in safety margin confirmed for the left edge and 0.25in sponsor padding is safe. Nina: re-export with those margins and resend the print file and I'll sign off.

Logan: I'll meet the dock marshal at 08:15 on Thursday to do the crate inventory check during stage-in. Sergio: please proceed with the FreightPlus order for the hotshot; Marissa approved the spend. Sergio, once you send the shipping_label_DEVCON227.pdf I'll forward to BrightSign and Tom so they have the routing.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Field Ops Lead, Events
Redwood Inference
(attachment: shipping_label_DEVCON227.pdf)
